integrity: Algebraic all-parameter argument; exact reproducible finite-field exhaustive test for the K6,6 instance. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The smallest-field statement concerns only matrices with every incidence-mask permitted coefficient nonzero; weakly masked matrices with zeros are not covered. title: Sharp field-eight realization of a full-support bipartite parity-check mask
